draftArchitecture.workedCase: A visitor opens /luminairy.html#mavens, selects one unfamiliar profile, saves one sentence and takes the Episode 04 quiz.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A later episode can use a different practice sequence only when its own authored activity supports it.

draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Existing hero, instruction, four-step list, save card and next-action link; no new layout or product.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: Do not turn a field trip into prompts, ratings, a social carousel or a generic reflection.
